tagline.zh: 现代 favicon 链的极小集:**5 图标 + 1 manifest** 覆盖所有需求,不必生成 20+ 张 PNG——ico 32×32 兜底 RSS/旧版、SVG 内嵌 prefers-color-scheme 自动换色、apple-touch 180×180 加内边距、192+512 maskable 走安全区,manifest 仅 PWA 需要。
tagline.en: The minimal modern favicon chain: **5 icons + 1 manifest** covers every need — no need to generate 20+ PNGs. The 32×32 ico as the RSS/legacy fallback, an SVG with embedded prefers-color-scheme for automatic recoloring, apple-touch at 180×180 with padding, 192+512 maskable inside the safe zone, and the manifest only when you ship a PWA.

origin.zh: 清单出自 Evil Martians《How to Favicon in 2024》(Andrey Sitnik,out/design-study/12-expansion.md §12):favicon.ico 32×32 放根目录(RSS 阅读器只认这个路径;sizes="32x32" 可修 Chrome 忽略 SVG 的 bug)→ icon.svg(现代浏览器,内嵌 <style> + prefers-color-scheme 暗色适配)→ apple-touch-icon.png 180×180(iOS,建议加 20px 内边距与背景色)→ icon-192.png + icon-mask.png 512×512(purpose:"maskable",安全区为 409×409 中央圆)+ manifest.webmanifest(仅 PWA)。彩蛋:staging 环境用反色 favicon 按环境切换防混淆。rel="shortcut icon" 从来不是有效写法。
origin.en: The checklist comes from Evil Martians' 'How to Favicon in 2024' (Andrey Sitnik, out/design-study/12-expansion.md §12): favicon.ico at 32×32 in the root (RSS readers only know that path; sizes="32x32" fixes Chrome's SVG-ignoring bug) → icon.svg (modern browsers, embedded <style> + prefers-color-scheme dark adaptation) → apple-touch-icon.png at 180×180 (iOS; add ~20px padding and a background color) → icon-192.png + icon-mask.png at 512×512 (purpose:"maskable", the safe zone is the central 409×409 circle) + manifest.webmanifest (PWAs only). Easter egg: a per-environment inverted-color favicon stops staging mix-ups. rel="shortcut icon" was never a valid value.

effect.zh: 配色方案开关(JS 型)。icon.svg 内嵌 <style> 的 @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) 会在系统深色模式自动把字形从 #0f0f0f 翻到 #f0f0f0(12 §12 官方片段定值);demo 以开关模拟 OS 偏好,同时把模拟浏览器 chrome 一起翻暗,还原真实观感。
effect.en: Color-scheme switch (JS-typed). The @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) block embedded in icon.svg's <style> flips the glyph from #0f0f0f to #f0f0f0 automatically under OS dark mode (exact values from the official snippet, 12 §12); the demo simulates the OS preference with this switch and darkens the mock browser chrome along with it, matching the real effect.

effect.zh: 浅色模式字形色(CSS 型)。默认 #0f0f0f = Evil Martians 片段的基础填充值;深色模式按片段翻为固定 #f0f0f0。改它等于改品牌主色——favicon 是品牌色在浏览器最小触点上的落地。
effect.en: Light-mode glyph color (CSS-typed). Default #0f0f0f = the base fill in the Evil Martians snippet; dark mode flips to the snippet's fixed #f0f0f0. Changing it is changing the brand color — the favicon is where brand color lands at the browser's smallest touchpoint.

effect.zh: apple-touch-icon 内边距(CSS 型,180 画布上的数值)。默认 20px = Evil Martians 对 iOS 图标的建议(建议加 20px 内边距与背景色);padding=0 时 glyph 顶边,系统一旦套圆角遮罩就有裁切风险。
effect.en: apple-touch-icon padding (CSS-typed, in 180-canvas units). Default 20px = Evil Martians' iOS advice (add ~20px padding and a background color); at padding=0 the glyph touches the edges, risking crops the moment the system applies its corner mask.

effect.zh: 安全区叠加层开关(JS 型):maskable 图标的 409×409 中央安全区(512 画布,比值 ≈0.8)。show 档画出虚线安全圆并给出圆形裁切预览——glyph 必须整体落在安全圆内;hide 档模拟「没标 purpose:"maskable"」的裸图,Android 启动器会按自家遮罩盲裁,四角内容随时被切。
effect.en: Safe-zone overlay switch (JS-typed): the maskable icon's 409×409 central safe zone (512 canvas, ratio ≈0.8). show draws the dashed safe circle plus a circular-crop preview — the glyph must fit entirely inside it; hide simulates a bare icon without purpose:"maskable", where the Android launcher blind-crops with its own mask and corner content gets cut at any time.

note.zh: 现代浏览器均支持(12 §12);favicon.ico 为旧浏览器与 RSS 阅读器的兜底(根目录 32×32);maskable 语义由支持 Web App Manifest 的 Android 启动器消费。SVG 内嵌
note.en: is supported by all modern browsers (12 §12); favicon.ico is the fallback for legacy browsers and RSS readers (root, 32×32); the maskable semantics are consumed by Android launchers that support Web App Manifest. Media queries embedded in the SVG's

fallback.zh: 兜底链就是体系本身:现代浏览器取 icon.svg,旧浏览器/RSS 回落根目录 favicon.ico(32×32),iOS 取 apple-touch-icon.png(180×180),Android PWA 取 192/512 maskable。任何一档缺失都有下一档接管——这正是「5+1」清单的排序逻辑;缺 ico 时 RSS 阅读器等只认 /favicon.ico 路径的客户端会拿不到图标。
fallback.en: The fallback chain IS the system: modern browsers take icon.svg, legacy browsers and RSS fall back to the root favicon.ico (32×32), iOS takes apple-touch-icon.png (180×180), Android PWAs take the 192/512 maskable pair. Each missing tier is covered by the next — that is the ordering logic of the '5+1' list; without the ico, clients that only know the /favicon.ico path (RSS readers) get no icon at all.

use.zh: 任何新站点/新品牌:一次配齐 5 图标 + 1 manifest,从此不再生成 20+ 张 PNG(Evil Martians 主张)
use.en: Any new site/brand: set up 5 icons + 1 manifest once and stop generating 20+ PNGs (Evil Martians' claim)

use.zh: 深浅双主题品牌:icon.svg 内嵌 prefers-color-scheme,系统切深色时 favicon 自动反色(12 §12 片段)
use.en: Brands with light/dark themes: embed prefers-color-scheme in icon.svg so the favicon inverts automatically under system dark mode (12 §12 snippet)

use.zh: 多环境部署:staging 环境用反色 favicon,一眼分辨测试站与生产站(Evil Martians 彩蛋)
use.en: Multi-environment deploys: an inverted-color favicon on staging tells test and production apart at a glance (Evil Martians easter egg)

use.zh: PWA/可安装应用:512×512 maskable(purpose:"maskable")+ 192 常规,glyph 落在 409×409 安全区内
use.en: PWAs/installable apps: 512×512 maskable (purpose:"maskable") plus a regular 192, glyph inside the 409×409 safe zone

avoid.zh: 给全平台手打 20+ 张尺寸 PNG——现代链路用 5+1 就够,旧尺寸由 ico 兜底
avoid.en: Hand-generating 20+ PNG sizes for every platform — the modern chain needs 5+1, with the ico covering legacy sizes

avoid.zh: 写 rel="shortcut icon"——从来不是有效 rel 值,现代浏览器只认 rel="icon"(12 §12)
avoid.en: Writing rel="shortcut icon" — it was never a valid rel value; modern browsers only recognize rel="icon" (12 §12)

avoid.zh: apple-touch-icon 顶边贴满:不带 20px 内边距与背景色,iOS 遮罩一裁就破相(12 §12 建议)
avoid.en: Edge-to-edge apple-touch icons: without ~20px padding and a background color, the iOS mask crops into the artwork (12 §12 advice)

avoid.zh: maskable 图标把关键内容画进四角:Android 启动器遮罩各异,只有 409×409 中央圆是承诺安全区(12 §12)
avoid.en: Putting key content in a maskable icon's corners: launcher masks vary — only the central 409×409 circle is the promised safe zone (12 §12)

a11y.zh: favicon 无障碍常被忽略的三点:①icon.svg 的暗色适配同时惠及深色模式用户与低视力用户——#f0f0f0 字形配深色 chrome 的对比度远好于黑 glyph 融进暗背景;②favicon 本身是装饰性图形,信息不应只由 favicon 传递(读屏器默认不播报站点图标);③staging 反色属于「用颜色区分环境」,务必同时配域名/横幅等非颜色通道,色弱用户不靠 hue 也能分辨(WCAG 1.4.1 颜色不是唯一手段的精神)。
a11y.en: Three often-missed a11y points for favicons: (1) icon.svg's dark adaptation serves dark-mode users and low-vision users alike — a #f0f0f0 glyph on a dark chrome contrasts far better than a black glyph dissolving into the dark background; (2) the favicon is decorative graphics — information must never ride on it alone (screen readers do not announce site icons by default); (3) staging's inverted color is 'distinguishing by color', so always pair it with domain/banner channels — color-blind users must be able to tell environments apart without hue (the spirit of WCAG 1.4.1, color not the only means).

goal.zh: 为一个站点配齐现代 favicon 链:根目录 32×32 ico、内嵌 prefers-color-scheme 的 icon.svg、180×180 带 20px 内边距与背景色的 apple-touch-icon、192 + 512 maskable 一对与 manifest(仅 PWA),并给出 <head> 接线代码。
goal.en: Set up the full modern favicon chain for a site: a root 32×32 ico, an icon.svg with embedded prefers-color-scheme, a 180×180 apple-touch-icon with 20px padding and background color, a 192 + 512 maskable pair, and a manifest (PWAs only), plus the <head> wiring code.

acceptance.zh: <head> 恰好四行接线:ico(sizes="32x32")、icon.svg(type="image/svg+xml")、apple-touch-icon、manifest;不出现 rel="shortcut icon"
acceptance.en: Exactly four <head> lines: ico (sizes="32x32"), icon.svg (type="image/svg+xml"), apple-touch-icon, manifest; no rel="shortcut icon"

acceptance.zh: icon.svg 内嵌 <style> 的 @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark):字形 #0f0f0f ↔ #f0f0f0 自动翻转
acceptance.en: icon.svg embeds @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) in <style>: glyph flips #0f0f0f ↔ #f0f0f0 automatically

acceptance.zh: apple-touch-icon 180×180,glyph 距边 ≥20px 且有背景色
acceptance.en: apple-touch-icon at 180×180 with the glyph ≥20px from edges and a background color

acceptance.zh: maskable 512×512 声明 purpose:"maskable",关键内容整体落在 409×409 中央圆内
acceptance.en: The 512×512 maskable declares purpose:"maskable" with all key content inside the central 409×409 circle

acceptance.zh: ico 固定 32×32 且位于站点根目录 /favicon.ico(RSS 阅读器只认该路径)
acceptance.en: The ico is fixed at 32×32 and sits at the site root /favicon.ico (the only path RSS readers know)
